profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Community Choice Financial Family of Brands
profile.summary:
• 15+ years as a Java developer and 10+ years of experience as a .Net  developer providing Production and Technical Support of Desktop, Client-Server and Web Based applications.
• Expert in debugging an application using the debugging tools provided by the Eclipse and Visual Studio.
• Experience in understanding and modifying the System Development Life Cycle (Planning, Analysis, Design, Implementation, Maintenance)
• Experience with ANSI C/C++, Assembly, C#, COBOL, Fortran, Java, .Net Frameworks, Pascal, PHP, Visual Basic in building Business Logic and other modules to build business solutions.
• Experience with Scripting Languages include: Bash, DOS Batch, KShell, Perl 
• Experience with AJAX, ASP, Atlassian products(Bitbucket, Bamboo, Jira, etc.), CVS, GIT, HL7, HTML, JavaScript, JSON, LINQ, Mercurial, RESTful services, SOA, TFS, WCF, WPF Web Services, VSS, X12, and XML
• Excellent understanding of concepts like polymorphisms, inheritance and encapsulation in an Object Oriented System.
• Experience in Developing Stored Procedure, Joins, Views, and Triggers using MSSQL Server Database, MySQL or DB2.
• Experience on Agile methodologies(KANBAN/Scrum), Waterfall methodologies, Conduct code, Peer reviews and Process Management.
• Experience working with web servers, such as Apache, IIS and Nginx.
• Strong technical background, excellent analytical ability and debugging skills. 
• Hands-on experience in writing and reviewing requirements, design documents and test 	plans.
• Good Interpersonal skills, Communication skills, System Analysis Skills and ability to work independently or as part of a team.
• Extensive experience in deploying and maintaining networked systems at the desktop and server level
• Extensive understanding of business as it relates to information system issues
• LAN/WAN design, installation, troubleshooting, and administration
• Firewall ACL setup and administration
• Network bandwidth analysis/bottleneck detection and elimination

company.name: Community Choice Financial Family of Brands

positions.title: Engineering Team Lead
positions.description: Contact point for team members. Co-ordinate customer projects between members to ensure timely delivery.  Test and  peer review code for technical accuracy, standards and functional compliance.  Provided technical assistance and training to other departments as required.  Participated in the SDLC.  Applied bug fixes and enhancements to existing applications and architecture.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Helped develop and design the Pulse Rx escripting project.  SQL query writer for the Pulse Meaningful Use reporting modules.  Lead engineer on the Silverlight migration of the Pulse patient portal project to a Java framework.  Linux system engineer for 2 development and 3 production systems.

positions.title: Application Development Engineer
positions.description: Data conversion of developed in-house Wichita Clinic EMR system to Via-Christi EMR.  Developed and implemented interfaces that communicated with the Kansas Prescription Drug Monitoring Program.  Developed scripting and query reports utilizing Microsoft SQL Server Reporting Services to interface with various analytic systems.  Led a team of three in design and implementation of a dictation solution utilizing Nuance’s Dragon Dictation software.

positions.title: Applications Analyst 2
positions.description: Developed, implemented, and maintained an in-house EMR System and corresponding database.  Responsible for creating and maintaining interfaces(HL7, X12, XML) from various ancillary systems(Billing, Lab, Radiology/PACS) that communicated information and interfaced with the EMR.  Developed the e-prescribe module and received formulary certification from RxHub and e-prescribe certification(4010, 5010, 5010A1) from SureScripts. Developed SQL reporting tools and queries that interfaced to the EMR.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Contract work and consulting for the nursing department chairperson.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description: Create backend applications for use within our clients’ websites.  Managed and administrated 1 Linux production web server.

positions.title: Technical Specialist
positions.description: Network administrator for a heterogeneous network comprised of 1 Novell Server, 16 WinNt servers, and 3 Win2K servers.  Responsible for active directory design, for VPN design and maintenance, database design and administration, workstation setup, help desk support, and network security design.
